submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "No One Explains VBAC to Black Women"
finding.problem: "I asked about vaginal birth after my C-section and the doctor laughed it off. I'm not allowed to 'argue' with doctors in my culture, but I deserve answers."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 30-yr-old diaspora mom; provider dismissed her VBAC questions; cultural barrier to "questioning the doctor"; wants evidence-based prep + birth plan.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (VBAC prep + provider-question script) — diaspora-differentiated.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
